title: sauvagesia insignis

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
